headline: Pakistan Foreign Economic Assistance Surges Threefold in Q1 FY27
summary: Pakistan received $5.445 billion in foreign economic assistance during the first quarter of FY2026-27, marking a threefold increase year-on-year.
why: External financing data provides vital insight into Pakistan's balance of payments stability and foreign reserve support from international partners.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: A threefold increase in foreign economic assistance improves external liquidity buffers.
